abstract: Gartner's 2025 predictions for IT organizations indicate that despite rapid AI adoption across enterprises, AI has not been a primary driver of workforce reductions. Less than 1% of enterprise layoffs in 2025 were directly attributed to AI, with most workforce changes occurring through gradual restructuring rather than AI-triggered disruptions.
keyFindings: Less than 1% of enterprise layoffs in 2025 were directly attributed to AI despite widespread AI adoption.
Most workforce changes in 2025 are characterized as gradual restructuring rather than sharp AI-driven reductions.
